sentences.text: Shri Akhilesh Kumar Singh - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Arvind Singh - Government Advocate for the responde
I.A. No.16174/2022, an application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence
and grant of bail to appellant Ravi Bansal arising out of judgment dated 06.05.2022 delivered in
Special Case No.24/2019, by Ii Additional Sessions Judge Kotma, District Anuppur (M.P.) is taken
up for consideration.

T he appellant has been convicted under Section 376(AB) of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.2,000/- with default stipulation and also convicted under Section 6 r/w 5-M of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Government counsel informed that the victim has been served.

As per prosecution story, on 27.02.2019 at around 7 pm, the victim was going to buy something from a shop and appellant chased her and when she reached near a bridge, her mouth was closed with the help of piece of cloth and she was forcibly taken under the bridge.
The appellant sexually assaulted her.
She became unconscious.
She did not inform about the incident to her mother on the same day.
Indeed, she informed her friend about the incident.
The said friend informed this to the mother of victim on the next day.
Thereafter, FIR was lodged.
The victim's samples were collected.
The spot map was prepared.
She was medically examined.
The DNA sample was taken and was sent for DNA test.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Para 25 of impugned judgment shows that the Court below has disbelieved the DNA report.
There is no FSL report, which supports the case of the prosecution.
By taking this Court to the statement of Dr. Deeparani (PW/9), it is submitted that there were no symptoms of sexual assault on the body of victim, who was aged about 11 years.
The said doctor candidly deposed that neither at the time of incident nor prior thereto any such incident had taken place is not reflected from physical examination of the victim.

Learned counsel for the appellant placed reliance on Para 18 of the statement of PW/1, the mother of victim wherein she admitted that her father Brajwasi gave his all movable and immovable Ravi Bansal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129376797/
1 property in the name of mother of accused namely Laxmi by way of a will.

sentences.text: The said property was also given to the cousin sister.
This became the reason of enmity between the parties because of which the appellant is falsely arraigned.
Learned counsel for the appellant has taken pains to take this Court through number of FIRs dated 03.07.2018, 07.05.2020, 16.06.2020, 12.08.2020 and 18.02.2022, which are filed from Page No.29 to 50.
The FIRs are lodged by mother of victim and by the victim against several persons relating to sexual assault.
They are habitual complainants.
Considering this aspect, various Benches of this Court have granted bail to accused persons.
Reliance is placed on the orders passed by this Court in MCRC.
No.42647/2020 dated 18.11.2020 (Gomti Prasad Bansal & Others vs. State of M.P.), MCRC.

sentences.text: It is submitted that it is a clear case of false implication.
The final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
Thus, remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
Government counsel opposed the prayer on the basis of objection.
We have heard the parties on this aspect.
Considering the factual backdrop and without expressing conclusive opinion on merits, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant.
Accordingly, I.A No.16174/2022 for appellant is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited), the remaining jail sentence of appellant - Ravi Bansal is hereby suspended and it is directed that the appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Trial Court Kotma, District Anuppur on 12 th June, 2023 and also on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
Certified copy as per rules.
